text:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH - gpu-pool-saturation in gcp-northamerica-northeast2 affecting model-ridge-prod. Autoscaler attempted scale but received quotaExceeded from Compute API. Link: https://console.redwood.example/incidents/1738204321 :rotating_light:

Alex K: oncall here — seeing a big request queue for model-ridge-prod, latency spiking to >3s for many requests. Autoscaler logs show `Provisioning failed: quotaExceeded: GPUs per project limit`.

Maria P: confirmed from metrics — queue length for ridge-worker queue 12k -> 48k over last 6m, token throughput down 60%. Retries increasing.

Derek S: tagging cloud-support-bot and @Sachin R — we need a quota bump or immediate reroute plan. Is cross-region routing enabled for this customer tier?

Sachin R: cross-region fallback is enabled for lower-tier route only. Prod customers are pinned to region for latency. We can temporarily serve on cpu-only smaller model for non-SLA customers. Suggest: 1) failover partial traffic to us-central1 (has spare capacity), 2) enable degraded model variant (ridge-small-quant) for background/async traffic, 3) open quota request with GCP support.

Alex K: steps I'm doing now:
- `kubectl get hpa -n prod ridge-deployment` -> HPA showing desired replicas 80 -> current 18.
- autoscaler controller logs (excerpt):
```
E 2025-06-04T21:12:37Z autoscaler.go:241 scaleUp error: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded. Supporting resource type: nvidia-tesla-a100, quota: 32
```

Maria P: runbook notes: if quota bump >30m, do traffic reroute. Can we spin warmpool in us-central1 using reserved preemptibles?

Sachin R: I can start a warmpool: `gcloud compute instances create-with-container warmpool-qa --region=us-central1 --accelerator=count=8,type=nvidia-tesla-a100 --machine-type=n1-standard-16 --preemptible` (will be best-effort). Might take ~4–6m to be usable.

Jen L: Customer-impact: Support dashboard shows 3% of active customers in region experiencing timeouts >= 10s, 12% showing degraded responses. A handful of paid SLO customers hitting error budget alerts. We should alert CS and set expectation.

Alex K: Escalation: opening cloud support ticket now. `gcloud compute quotas list --project redwood-prod --format=json` shows GPUs 32/32 used in region. Raising request for temporary soft-limit increase to 80. Ticket opened: CS-984321, attaching logs.

incident-bot: Update: Incident severity remains P1. Pager duty: page oncall-secondary in 5m if not resolved.

Derek S: Short-term mitigation plan we agreed on: 1) Start warmpool in us-central1 (Sachin), 2) Deploy routing override to send 30% of non-enterprise traffic to us-central1 (Alex), 3) Enable ridge-small-quant variant behind feature-flag for async jobs (Maria), 4) Request cloud quota increase and escalate via phone (Alex + Derek).

Sachin R: warmpool create started — container image pulled, acceleration attach in progress. ETA ~5m.

Maria P: deploying ridge-small-quant can be done in 3–4m. I'll patch the routing rules to mark it for `background` jobtype only.

Alex K: applying traffic rule now: `redwoodctl routes apply -f /tmp/reroute-northamerica.json` -> pushing 30% -> pushing... accepted. Starting canary.

Jen L: FYI I'm drafting a status note to customers impacted and adding the initial mitigation steps. Will ping once ready for send.

incident-bot: autoscaler health check: 2025-06-04T21:18:02Z - still failing to scale due to quota, but 30% reroute active, queue slope reduced to +8k.

Alex K: Warmpool nodes became Ready in us-central1. Spinning up inference pods and attaching to ridge-prod pool. Initial pods report model load successful but with slightly higher p99 (~220ms extra).

Maria P: After warmpool join latency: overall request drop from 12%->6%, queue is plateauing at ~20k. Good improvement but not fully clear.

Derek S: Next: try to free ephemeral GPUs in region by shrinking non-prod pools and evicting batch jobs. Maria, can you start evicting staging GPU jobs?

Maria P: starting eviction of staging/gpu workloads now. `kubectl delete pod -l env=staging,gpu=true -n staging` -> freed 12 GPUs. Autoscaler retried provisioning and got new quota error cleared?

cloud-support-bot: Support update: GCP case CS-984321 updated — support acknowledged and set target 45m for decision on temporary regional quota raise. Phone escalation queued.

Alex K: After freeing staging GPUs, autoscaler log: `Provisioning succeeded: created instance group ridge-pool-b` -> we got 8 GPUs back in region. Queue correspondingly dipped.

Jen L: Customer-impact update: timeouts now affecting 1.1% of traffic, degraded responses at 4%. Sending brief to CS and support ops.

Derek S: Handing off to Derek S (next oncall) for the remainder — I'll stay on the thread for the quota escalation call. Oncall handoff time 21:28 UTC. @Derek S you own incident until clear.

Derek S: taking over. Current state: partial mitigations applied, warmpool in us-central1, routing override at 30%, staging evicted, waiting on GCP decision. Next actions: 1) If GCP approve -> scale up further and drain warmpool. 2) If no approval -> extend reroute to 50% and enable ridge-cpu-fallback for non-critical flows.

incident-bot: Note: Incident timeline created. Please add important logs to the incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.example/incidents/1738204321

Sachin R: FYI ran `gcloud compute regions describe northamerica-northeast2 --project=redwood-prod` -> returned quota limits: GPUs: 32 (used 28). There was a stray batch job that re-requested 8 GPUs concurrently; eviction freed them.

Derek S: I'll coordinate the quota phone call in 10m. @Alex K please keep monitoring queue slope and error budget alerts.

Maria P: I'll keep the staging eviction in place until we confirm either GCP bump or we have capacity in other regions.

Jen L: prepping customer comms: short note to impacted customers with ETA 45–60m for resolution or mitigation.

incident-bot: Last automated update at 2025-06-04T21:32:01Z - remediation in progress, next update on manual post or when GCP responds.

Derek S: status summary for handoff: mitigations in place, customer impact reduced but not eliminated, quota request pending with support, warmpool active, followup owner: Derek S.

Alex K: leaving channel for sleep but monitoring alerts on pager. Good handoff — call me if quota approved or error rises >2% again. Good work team :thumbsup:

Derek S: thanks all. Adding a tidy-up checklist to the incident doc: rollback routing override after capacity stable, resume staging jobs, review autoscaler backoff behavior.

Maria P: agreed — postmortem notes will include: clearer preemption policy for staging, automated cross-region failover for pinned enterprise tenants, and a quota monitoring alert at 80% regional GPU usage.

incident-bot: Incident P1 remains open. Please update incident doc with any further actions.
